purpose: Separate conditional action structure from legal-move support, simple goal preference, persistence and native observation coverage before biological-specificity claims.
source_only: Same6000 first-goal-censored recorded transitions/species from train individuals and layouts1–5; no other native path/cells read by helper. Source camera and frozen belief arrays remain byte-identical.
policy: For each source row, softmax over actual legal neighboring moves: kappa*indicator(current action equals previous recorded move)+beta*(d(current cell)-d(candidate next cell)). Distance is to source goal on source maze, for OFFLINE labels only. No legal mask/goal/map added to acting policy.

fit.objective: Negative conditional log likelihood of real6000 recorded moving labels; no brain/update-rule identification.

label_arms.rat_surrogate: Sample fitted rat policy at exactly rat input rows
label_arms.human_surrogate: Sample fitted human policy at exactly human input rows
label_arms.rat_legal_uniform: Sample beta=kappa=0 over legal moves at exactly rat input rows
label_arms.human_legal_uniform: Sample beta=kappa=0 over legal moves at exactly human input rows

randomness: Surrogates seed641793+species index; uniform-legal seed642793+species index. One label/unique move repeated over3 texture reconstructions, X/identity not changed. Never resample favorable labels.
why_uniform_control: Original subject/layout shams sometimes assign illegal moves. Legal-uniform preserves cellwise available action support without goal/persistence fitting, rather than interpreting a sham gap as uniquely biological. Original expert deterministically breaks shortest-path ties; stochastic controls remove reliance on that direction tie bias.

learner_followup.bc: Identical20epochs/360000 presentations/Adam.001/clip.5; freshPPOoptimizer; fixed source arrays
learner_followup.status: Implementation and independent dry/data audit/GO required before learner fitting; statistical-label fitting and generation have their own narrowly scoped GO.

confirmation_boundary: Added arms may enter fresh confirmation only with a hash-bound addendum BEFORE any target policy outcomes. All original7 arms remain; no sample deletion or selecting favorable old seeds.
failure_policy: Preserve nonconvergence/partial/numerical/implementation errors; no silent retries or new seeds. Independent legality/identity/likelihood/gradient/hash checks before labels or downstream fits are interpreted.
